title: A transition can be copied from one cut and pasted onto others
goal: Tune a dissolve at one cut, and today there is no way to put the same one on another cut except setting it up again. The transition mock gives a cut Copy Transition, and Paste puts it on the picked cut or cuts. Premiere and Final Cut both work this way.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-transitions.html panel overflow menu 'Copy transition'. Code: the cut's right-click is EditorState+TimelineMenus.swift ~553-578 (Apply Default Transition, Add, Remove, Roll Edit); no transition handling in EditorState+Clipboard.swift or PhotonzCore/Clipboard.swift. Apply to Every Cut and Set as Default exist (one-step-puts-a-transition-on-every-cut, one-key-puts-the-usual-transition-on-the-cut-at). Searches 'copy transition', 'paste transition': nothing.
acceptance: At Next defaults: right-click a cut with a transition and choose Copy Transition; pick another cut (or several) and Paste (Command V and the right-click row): each gets the same kind, length and curve, in one undo step
Pasting where a cut cannot afford it greys or refuses the same way the picker does and says why
Edit > Copy and Paste reach it with a cut picked; no new key is added

A walk at Next defaults covers it and passes twice; a core test pins the copy; audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Review before building: Premiere/FCP users pick the transition or edit point, Cmd C, pick other edit points, Cmd V; the app has one picked cut at a time, so 'several' follows Cmd T's spread (ruler range, track range, two or more clips picked) and a lone Cmd V with nothing picked lands on the cut at the playhead. Mock (#propMenu) puts Copy transition in the panel menu; the app had no panel menu on a cut, so one was added to the Transition header (follow-up filed to move it onto the mock's Properties header). A dip's hold is real time, so a paste never copies it.

Built: PhotonzCore/TransitionClipboard.swift (CopiedTransition, ClipCut.fitted(pasting:), PhotonzDocument.copyTransition/transitionPastePlan/pasteTransition) + 9 tests; CopyConfirmation .transitionCopied; app EditorState+TransitionClipboard.swift (Edit Copy/Cut/Paste routing via copyWhatIsInHand etc., cut and edit point right-click rows), TransitionPanelMenu on the Transition header with Copy, Paste and the mock's Reset to Default Length (also in Clip > Transition at Cut).

Verified: Scripts/test.sh 13322 tests green; transition-copy-paste-walk ok twice at Next defaults (no flags); default-transition-key, roll-the-cut-between-two-clips, timeline-right-click, transition-on-every-cut walks re-run ok since the cut menu gained rows. Looked at pictures 1-tuned, 2-copied (pill 'Copied Cross dissolve, 0.2s'), 3-cut-menu (Copy greyed on hard cut, Paste live, Cmd C/Cmd V printed), 4-pasted (second cut at 0:04 wears Cross dissolve 0.2s Ease in), 5-reset (0.4s, curve kept).

left rough: Down arrow moves the playhead to the next cut but keeps the earlier cut picked, so Cmd V then pastes on the picked cut (same rule Cmd T follows); not filed, an existing pick rule, asked in the audit's evaluate.

left rough: a paste longer than a cut can pay for comes in shorter without a word (same as the picker's fitting); asked in evaluate rather than filed. The single-cut refusal (no spare at all) is unit tested, not walked: the sample recording cannot make a cut with no spare.
Mock difference filed: with-a-cut-picked-the-panel-opens-under-the-prop (p1) for the missing Properties header on a picked cut; Title Case rows settled by UX-PATTERNS §7.
